ic.overview.title: Welcome to the CARP Test Study
ic.overview.summary: This technical study checks that CARP Study App configurations work as expected.
ic.overview.content: You are invited to test study setup, sensing, surveys, media capture, health integration and cognitive tasks. This is a technical test protocol, not a clinical study.
ic.who.title: Who runs this test?
ic.who.summary: The CARP development and research team at the Technical University of Denmark runs this test.
ic.who.content: The Copenhagen Center for Health Technology at the Technical University of Denmark maintains the CARP platform and uses this protocol for technical validation.
ic.tasks.title: What will I do?
ic.tasks.summary: You may try surveys, cognitive tests, audio recording, image capture, health import and environmental sensing.
ic.tasks.content: The available test tasks include a mixed-format survey, Flanker, reaction-time and tapping activities, a short audio recording, an image capture, manual health-data import and one-time environmental sensing.
ic.data.title: What data is collected?
ic.data.summary: The protocol can collect device, sensor, connectivity, location, environment, health, media and task-result data.
ic.data.content: Test only with data you are comfortable uploading. The configuration retains uploaded data on the phone to support comparison during testing. Data is handled according to the CARP service privacy policy and applicable data-protection rules.
ic.location.title: Location
ic.location.summary: Where the phone is, including while the app is in the background.
ic.location.content: Location and mobility are sampled by the protocol and by the environment, audio and survey tasks. The phone asks first for location while using the app, and then for background location. You can withdraw either at any time in the phone settings.
ic.activity.title: Physical activity
ic.activity.summary: Steps and whether you are still, walking, cycling or in a vehicle.
ic.activity.content: This comes from the phone's own activity recognition - no additional sensor is used, and it says what kind of movement is happening, not where.
ic.bluetooth.title: Nearby devices
ic.bluetooth.summary: Bluetooth is used to see nearby devices and to connect study sensors.
ic.bluetooth.content: The test protocol can connect a Polar heart rate sensor and a Movesense device, and records which Bluetooth and Wi-Fi devices are around. Nothing is sent to those devices.
ic.microphone.title: Microphone
ic.microphone.summary: The audio and video tasks record sound while you run them.
ic.microphone.content: Recording only happens while one of those tasks is open - nothing is picked up in the background. You hear what was recorded before it is submitted.
ic.camera.title: Camera
ic.camera.summary: The image and video tasks use the camera while you run them.
ic.camera.content: The camera is only opened by those tasks, and you see and confirm each capture before it is submitted.
ic.notification.title: Reminders
ic.notification.summary: Notifications tell you when a study task is ready or due.
ic.notification.content: Without them you would have to open the app to find out that a task is waiting. They are ordinary notifications and can be turned off in the phone settings at any time.
ic.health.title: Health data
ic.health.summary: The test reads steps, distance, heart rate and skin temperature from the phone health service.
ic.health.content: Each data type is authorised separately by Apple Health or Health Connect, so you can grant only the ones you are comfortable sharing. Nothing is written back to the health service.
ic.background.title: Collecting while the app is closed
ic.background.summary: Sensing continues while the app is in the background, which the phone must be told not to interrupt.
ic.background.content: Android will open a settings page asking to leave this app out of battery optimization - without it the phone suspends the app and sampling stops. Return to the app afterwards to continue. You can undo it at any time in the phone settings.
ic.rights.title: Voluntary participation
ic.rights.summary: Participation is voluntary and you can stop at any time.
ic.rights.content: You may skip optional questions, deny permissions, stop using the app or leave the study without giving a reason.
ic.summary.title: Consent summary
ic.summary.summary: You understand that this is a technical test and agree to the configured data collection.
ic.summary.content: By continuing, you confirm that you have read the information, understand the test activities and data collection, and participate voluntarily.
ic.review.title: Consent to the CARP Test Study
ic.review.reason: Do you understand the technical test and consent to participate?
ic.review.text: Review and sign below to continue.
ic.completion.title: Consent saved
ic.completion.text: Thank you. You can now use the test protocol.
study.description.title: CARP Test Study
study.description.purpose: To verify CARP Study App configuration, sensing, services, user tasks and task scheduling with CAMS 2.x.
study.description.description: A short-cycle technical protocol covering passive sensing, connected services, health data, surveys, media capture and cognitive assessments.
study.responsible.name: CARP Team
study.responsible.title: Research and Development Team

task.audio.instructions: Record a few seconds of speech, then stop and submit the recording.

task.image.instructions: Take a non-sensitive test photo and submit it.

survey.configuration.description: Tests common survey question and answer formats.
survey.configuration.intro.title: Survey component test
survey.configuration.intro.text: This survey exercises single choice, multiple choice, slider, integer, date/time and free-text inputs.
survey.configuration.multiple_choice: Which task groups did you test?
survey.configuration.slider: Rate the overall experience from 0 to 10.
survey.configuration.integer: How many seconds did your test take?
